topic: Sweep the plan-4/plan-5 deferred minors backlog: fourteen small, independently verifiable fixes and two rulings, filed as GitHub issues #1 #2 #3 #4 #5 #6 #9 #10 #11 #12 #13 #14 #15 #16 on monrad/takt. Each issue already states its fix shape. Group by file so tasks stay disjoint: cmd_version.go takes #3 (--expect "" must fail the handshake, not pass), #10 (ManifestMatches evaluated twice) and #11 (mismatch text says "plugin" on the Copilot host); gitx + cmd_init.go take #6 (init/next fail when .git/info/exclude is read-only — degrade to a warning) and #12 (EnsureExclude writes the bundle path unescaped); cmd_next.go takes #5 (briefs written non-atomically — wants bundle.WriteFileAtomic) and #4 (a --force takeover from a generated session over a generated holder records no lock_taken — decide log-always vs document). Standalone: #9 (config lock_ttl and wave_stale_after not validated > 0), #1 (planner brief template renders validation problems outside the delimiter quote), #14 (hostgen message polish and --root-unaware paths), #13 (task build does not stamp the version), #15 (test gaps: lock steal boundary, cross-prompt invariant sentences, quotedScalarProblem escape look-back, writeLogsIgnore already-present case). Two need a ruling before code: #16 (endAttemptStreak swallows read and append errors — keep documented or fail loud) and #4 above; #2 is the spec §4.6 doc sentence that follows whatever #4 decides. Out of scope: #34 (open PR #38 on fix/doctor-finding-count) and everything in the diagnostics, retro and review-layer clusters. Green afterwards: go test -race ./... and golangci-lint run ./...

last_digest.summary: Fixed the version handshake in internal/cli/cmd_version.go (empty --expect now fails via flag.Visit detection, manifestFailure judges once and returns dev too, and failure text names "skill" vs "plugin" per flag), with matching test coverage added/extended in cmd_version_test.go; all three verify commands pass.

Converted the planner brief's rejection list to the shared `{{if .Problems}}...{{quote .Token "rejection" ...}}` shape used by the other three templates, and extended `TestRejectionReasonsAreQuotedBackOnTheRetry` to cover the planner via `assertRejectionSection`.

Both hostgen failures share one `fmt.Errorf` style naming the src the process read, and the missing regression coverage now exists at both layers — a `run()`-level test that reads stderr under a non-default `--root`, and a renderer-level table covering the no-description branch.

Added a `--print` mode to `internal/tools/setversion` (reads the plugin manifest's version via the existing regexp, writes nothing) with new tests, and wired `Taskfile.yml`'s `build` task to shell that out into an `-ldflags` var so `task build -o takt ./cmd/takt` stamps the binary while a plain `go build ./...` stays as the compile check for the rest of the tree.

Added TestAcquireStealBoundaryAndSelfStale (lock_test.go), TestPromptInvariantsReadTheSameOnEveryHost (prompt_test.go), and TestQuotedScalarProblemBackslashRuns plus a backslash-run-parity fix to the test-only quotedScalarProblem helper (copilot_test.go); also updated copilot_test.go's `hosts.RenderCopilotAgent` call to the 3-arg signature already landed by a concurrent task so the package compiles.
Added the `warnings` contract — `op.Op.Warnings []string` with `omitempty`, a `keyWarnings` constant in cli.go, and op_test.go coverage for both absent and present cases.
